architecture_decisions.rationale: When() expressions were incorrectly passing _connector and _negated arguments into Q() objects. This fix adds validation in When and moves PROHIBITED_FILTER_KWARGS for proper reuse.

tickets.title: Avoid propagating invalid arguments from When() to Q()
tickets.description: When() expressions were incorrectly passing _connector and _negated arguments into Q() objects. This fix adds validation in When and moves PROHIBITED_FILTER_KWARGS for proper reuse.

implementation_summary: This change implements 'Avoid propagating invalid arguments from When() to Q()' for django. When() expressions were incorrectly passing _connector and _negated arguments into Q() objects. This fix adds validation in When and moves PROHIBITED_FILTER_KWARGS for proper reuse. Modified files: django/db/models/expressions.py, django/db/models/query.py, django/db/models/query_utils.py, tests/expressions_case/tests.py.
